dedupe_keys.name: aerocloud intelligent airport management system iams and airport operations system

description: AeroCloud Systems sells iAMS, a modular, cloud-native Intelligent Airport Management System whose Airport Operations System (AOS) brings an airport's operational data into one web platform. Contents and modules: flight management, gate management, flight information displays, asset management, inspection management, common use passenger processing (CUPPS), departure control, self-service and passenger verification, and AeroCloud Optic, which counts and tracks passengers anonymously in real time from curb to gate. Coverage: sold to airports, fixed-base operators, ground handlers and airlines; a customer quote describes sending alerts to tenants and ground teams during irregular operations and diversions. Format and access: a web service reachable from any device, with no limits on users and no per-user licence charges; modules are bought as needed. Licence and cost: proprietary; price on request. Caveats: vendor information only, and no data are public. Its live flight, gate and passenger flow data can drive digital twin, capacity planning and emergency response work at an airport, such as studying diversions or terminal crowding. It relates to the AirTOP simulator in the catalogue.
